'''Rachele Ree''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a member of the old [[Wukkar aristocracy|aristocracy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. She was known for having vast knowledge of everyone or anything on the planet. She helped the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during a [[Marblewood Estate heist|complex heist]] on the [[Marblewood Estate]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
